news.titleEn: Fed raises interest rates for the first time since 2023
news.conclusionEn: The FOMC voted 12-0 to lift the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00%, and officials pencilled in one more hike in 2026.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储12比0通过加息25个基点至3.75%-4.00%。
news.whyEn: It reverses the easing cycle and raises borrowing costs for households, companies and governments worldwide.
news.whyZh: 政策转向抬高全球家庭、企业和政府的借贷成本。
news.detailEn: The hike is the Fed's first since 2023 and came under Chair Kevin Warsh, as sticky inflation, strong jobs data and high oil prices pushed policymakers to tighten. Stocks fell after the announcement, with the Dow dropping about 650 points, while bond yields rose and the US dollar strengthened. Policymakers signalled one more increase this year, though futures markets were pricing meaningful odds of two.
news.detailZh: 这是美联储自2023年以来首次加息，由主席沃什主持。通胀居高不下、就业数据强劲加上油价高企，促使决策者收紧政策。宣布后美股下跌，道指一度下挫约650点，国债收益率和美元走高。官员暗示年内还会再加息一次，但期货市场认为加息两次的概率不容忽视。

news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007 ahead of Fed rate decision
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed as high as 5.04% on September 15, closing near 5%, its highest close since 2007.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10年期国债收益率升至5%上方，为2007年来最高。
news.whyEn: The 10-year yield anchors mortgage rates and corporate borrowing costs, and a 5% yield competes directly with stocks for investor money.
news.whyZh: 10年期收益率是房贷和企业融资成本的锚，5%的无风险收益直接与股市争夺资金。
news.detailEn: Yields jumped as oil prices surged on the Iran conflict and traders bet on a Fed hike, with inflation still well above the 2% target. The 5% level is seen as a psychological threshold that could strain an already stretched equity rally. Wall Street ended the following week mixed, with the Dow and S&P 500 posting small weekly losses while the Nasdaq edged higher.
news.detailZh: 伊朗冲突推高油价，同时市场押注美联储加息，通胀仍明显高于2%目标，收益率因此飙升。5%被视为心理关口，可能压制已经偏高的股市涨势。随后一周美股涨跌不一，道指和标普500小幅周跌，纳指小幅收涨。

news.titleEn: U.S. forces hit IRGC-linked oil tankers as oil nears $100 a barrel
news.conclusionEn: The US-Iran war keeps oil elevated: CENTCOM destroyed five IRGC-linked tankers and Iran fired missiles at US positions in Jordan.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊战事持续，美军击毁五艘伊朗关联油轮，油价居高。
news.whyEn: Disruption around the Strait of Hormuz feeds oil, inflation and bond yields, and therefore the Fed's rate path.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡受扰推高油价、通胀和收益率，并影响美联储路径。
news.detailEn: In the latest CBS live coverage (September 8), CENTCOM said it destroyed five IRGC-linked tankers after Iranian missile attacks on a US Navy warship, and Jordan intercepted 18 ballistic missiles aimed at US positions. Brent was near $97 at that point, and later reports this month have had oil back above $100 a barrel. Note this item reflects the last verified update from this source, older than 48 hours, but the conflict remains a main driver of markets.
news.detailZh: 据CBS 9月8日的直播报道，美军中央司令部称，在伊朗导弹袭击美国海军军舰后，击毁了五艘与革命卫队有关的油轮；约旦拦截了18枚射向美军阵地的弹道导弹。当时布伦特原油约97美元，本月稍后报道称油价已重回100美元上方。需说明：本条依据该信源最近一次核实的更新，已超过48小时，但冲突仍是当前市场的主要驱动因素。

news.titleEn: Nvidia CEO says AI chip demand will double sales again in 2027
news.conclusionEn: Jensen Huang said on September 17 that Nvidia expects to sell twice as many chips in 2027 as in 2026.
news.conclusionZh: 黄仁勋称英伟达2027年芯片销量将翻倍。
news.whyEn: Nvidia's outlook is a bellwether for AI capital spending and for a market rally largely powered by AI earnings.
news.whyZh: 英伟达的展望是AI资本开支和AI驱动型股市行情的风向标。
news.detailEn: Huang made the remarks at an event in the UK, saying countries and companies want to invest in AI almost everywhere Nvidia operates. Reports say the Vera Rubin platform is expected to be the fastest product ramp in the company's history, though the supply chain may not keep up with all demand. The comments lifted Nvidia shares about 2%.
news.detailZh: 黄仁勋在英国的一场活动上表示，英伟达业务所在的几乎所有国家都想投资AI。报道称Vera Rubin平台预计将成为公司史上最快的产品放量，但供应链可能无法满足全部需求。这番言论推动英伟达股价上涨约2%。

news.titleEn: Zuckerberg, Musk And Huang Reportedly Convinced Trump To Block AI Regulator
news.conclusionEn: Tech CEOs reportedly urged Trump to drop a proposed industry-funded AI regulator, and he did not move forward with it.
news.conclusionZh: 科技大佬据报说服特朗普放弃行业出资的AI监管机构。
news.whyEn: It shapes how tightly frontier AI models will be overseen in the US, affecting every major AI developer and investor.
news.whyZh: 这决定美国前沿AI模型的监管松紧，影响所有主要AI公司和投资者。
news.detailEn: The proposal, associated with Google's Demis Hassabis and modelled partly on FINRA, would have created a body to test frontier models for cyber, biological and deceptive risks before release. Zuckerberg, Musk and Huang reportedly argued that labs already have incentives to be safe and that the structure could concentrate influence around OpenAI, Anthropic and Google. Trump ultimately did not advance the idea, keeping the administration's light-touch approach.
news.detailZh: 该提案与谷歌的哈萨比斯有关，部分参照美国金融业监管局（FINRA）设计，将在前沿模型发布前测试其网络、生物和欺骗性风险。据报道，扎克伯格、马斯克和黄仁勋认为各实验室本就有安全动力，且这种架构可能使影响力集中于OpenAI、Anthropic和谷歌。特朗普最终没有推进，延续了政府轻监管的立场。

news.titleEn: Microsoft exec called AI scraping 'the largest theft of labor in human history,' new unredacted filings reveal
news.conclusionEn: Unredacted filings in The New York Times' lawsuit show internal doubts at Microsoft and OpenAI about AI training on scraped content.
news.conclusionZh: 《纽约时报》诉讼的未编辑文件披露微软、OpenAI内部质疑。
news.whyEn: The case could set legal and financial precedent for how AI companies source training data.
news.whyZh: 该案可能为AI公司获取训练数据的法律和成本树立先例。
news.detailEn: The filings quote a Microsoft applied-science director calling mass scraping of journalism an astonishing theft, and an OpenAI executive saying its products were largely substitutive. They also allege paywalls were bypassed and copyright notices stripped from training data. Both companies declined to comment on specifics, and Microsoft said the executive's views were personal rather than company policy.
news.detailZh: 文件引述微软一名应用科学总监称大规模抓取新闻内容是「惊人的盗窃」，并引述OpenAI高管称其产品在很大程度上具有替代性。文件还指称有人绕过付费墙、并从训练数据中删除版权声明。两家公司均拒绝就具体内容置评，微软称该高管的观点属个人看法，不代表公司政策。

news.titleEn: Oversight Board blasts 'inadequate' Meta safeguards for AI deepfakes
news.conclusionEn: Meta's Oversight Board ordered two AI-generated videos removed from Facebook and called the company's deepfake safeguards inadequate.
news.conclusionZh: Meta监督委员会下令删除两段AI深度伪造视频。
news.whyEn: Binding rulings on deepfakes raise compliance pressure on Meta and signal tougher standards for platforms.
news.whyZh: 具约束力的裁决加大Meta合规压力，也预示平台标准趋严。
news.detailEn: One video falsely showed a Scottish politician making inflammatory remarks about refugees; the other targeted a young Muslim woman. Meta had earlier declined to remove the content because trusted partners had not flagged it. The board described existing safeguards as consistently and fundamentally inadequate and recommended nine policy changes, including reduced distribution of high-risk content and warning screens.
news.detailZh: 其中一段视频虚假描绘一名苏格兰政客发表针对难民的煽动性言论，另一段针对一名年轻穆斯林女性。Meta此前因可信合作伙伴未举报而拒绝删除。委员会称现有防护措施「一贯且根本性地不足」，并提出九项政策修改建议，包括降低高风险内容的分发和增加警示页面。

businessTips.explanationEn: The Pareto Principle observes that roughly 80% of results often come from 20% of causes. It is a rule of thumb, not a law, but it helps managers focus scarce time and money on the few inputs that matter most. Reviewing which customers, products or tasks drive most of the value is the practical starting point.
businessTips.explanationZh: 帕累托法则指出，大约80%的结果往往来自20%的原因。它是经验法则而非定律，但能帮助管理者把有限的时间和资金集中在最关键的少数投入上。实际做法是先复盘哪些客户、产品或任务贡献了大部分价值。
businessTips.exampleEn: A software company finds 18% of its customers generate 75% of revenue. It assigns its best support staff to them and stops discounting low-value accounts.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家软件公司发现18%的客户贡献了75%的收入，于是把最好的客服资源分配给这些客户，并停止给低价值账户打折。

businessTips.explanationEn: The cash conversion cycle measures how many days pass between paying for inventory or materials and collecting cash from customers. It equals days inventory outstanding plus days sales outstanding minus days payables outstanding. A shorter cycle means less cash is trapped in operations, which matters greatly for small businesses that fail more often from cash shortages than from lack of profit.
businessTips.explanationZh: 现金转换周期衡量从支付库存或材料款到从客户收回现金之间相隔多少天，等于库存周转天数加应收账款天数减应付账款天数。周期越短，被运营占用的现金越少。这对小企业尤其重要，因为它们更常死于现金短缺而非缺乏利润。
businessTips.exampleEn: An online shop pays suppliers in 15 days, holds stock for 45 days and gets paid instantly. Negotiating 45-day supplier terms cuts its cycle from 30 days to zero and frees cash for growth.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家网店15天付供应商货款、库存放45天、客户即时付款。若谈到45天账期，现金转换周期从30天降到0天，释放出的现金可用于扩张。

businessTips.explanationEn: Real yield is the nominal return on an investment minus inflation, showing how much purchasing power you actually gain. A 5% bond yield is worth little if inflation is 4%. Investors watch real yields on government bonds because they set the hurdle rate that risky assets like stocks must beat.
businessTips.explanationZh: 实际收益率等于名义收益率减去通胀，反映购买力真正增加了多少。若通胀为4%，5%的债券收益率就没那么值钱。投资者关注国债的实际收益率，因为它决定了股票等风险资产必须跨越的门槛。
businessTips.exampleEn: With the 10-year Treasury near 5% and inflation around 3.5%, the real yield is about 1.5%. If it rises further, investors may shift from richly valued stocks toward bonds.
businessTips.exampleZh: 10年期美债收益率接近5%、通胀约3.5%时，实际收益率约1.5%。若继续上升，投资者可能从估值偏高的股票转向债券。
